result.summary: Found two minor layout issues concerning safe area padding and text truncation.

issues.description: The system gesture indicator bar overlaps the bottom tab navigation icons, particularly obscuring the search icon.
issues.suggestion: Incorporate proper safe area inset padding to prevent system elements from overlapping the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement text-overflow truncation with an ellipsis or adjust the container width/font size.
